newsitem.title: DUBAI: Arab programme has given $626 mln credit since '91.
newsitem.headline: Arab programme has given $626 mln credit since '91.

text.p: The Arab Trade Financing Programme (ATFP) said on Thursday it had extended $626 million in credit lines of a total $977 million applied for by Arab states since it started operating in 1991.
Between August and November this year, it received requests for $97 million in credit lines, it said after a meeting of its board of directors.
The ATFP was set up to develop and promote trade among Arab countries by extending lines of credit.
It is 50 percent owned by the Abu Dhabi-based Arab Monetary Fund and other institutions. It does not finance oil and gas, re-exports or used items.
